body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Round 1: 5 Cursor specialists (correctness slot failed) + Codex generic. Round 1 accepted 8 findings (1 normative source gap + 7 script-forwarding gaps), all folded inline. Non-substantial findings rejected (3).

## Rejected Code Review Findings

### [Code Review] Cursor-Edge-cases (round 1) / Codex-generic (round 1)
**Finding**: Finding #10 — `skills/implement/SKILL.md:134` vs `scripts/session-setup.sh`: SKILL says `--run-id` overrides the run ID but `session-setup.sh` has no `--run-id` input and always allocates a fresh SESSION_TMPDIR and SESSION_ID.
**Reason not implemented**: By design — actual propagation to session state and `larch-logs/` is explicitly deferred to #1438. The SKILL.md already notes "actual propagation deferred to #1438" in the description wording. This finding is the expected future work.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Edge-cases (round 1)
**Finding**: Finding #12 — Naming collision: `--run-id` is used in CI scripts (`ci-rerun-failed.sh`, `gh-run-logs.sh`) for GitHub Actions run IDs, and now also in skill SKILL.md for session run identifiers. Could confuse LLMs or humans in `/implement` Step 12c transcript.
**Reason not implemented**: The flag name `--run-id` is specified by the issue (#1877) and is the intentional design choice. Renaming is out of scope for this PR. The contexts are clearly distinct (CI scripts receive `FAILED_RUN_ID` from `ci-wait.sh`; the skill flag is part of `$ARGUMENTS` parsing).

### [Code Review] Cursor-Edge-cases (round 1)
**Finding**: Finding #13 — cleanup/upgrade-larch/test-issue document `--run-id` but invoke fixed no-arg scripts; operators might infer script-level behavior that doesn't exist.
**Reason not implemented**: These three skills accept no arguments today. The `--run-id` flag in their `## Flags` section is an orchestrator-level hint (consistent with how other no-arg flags work in larch — documented at the skill level, not necessarily wired to the underlying script). Adding "orchestrator-only" clarification would be a follow-up in #1438 when actual wiring is done.
